    def remaining_layout(self, label):
        prefix = self.labels["left"].get_text() + " "
        value = label.get_text()
        body = value[len(prefix):] if value.startswith(prefix) else value
        prefix_layout = label.create_pango_layout(prefix)
        body_layout = label.create_pango_layout(body)
        prefix_width, _ = prefix_layout.get_pixel_size()
        available = min(label.get_allocated_width(), max(40, self._screen.width // 2 - 44))
        return prefix_layout, body_layout, prefix_width, max(1, available - prefix_width)

    def draw_remaining(self, label, cr):
        prefix, body, prefix_width, available = self.remaining_layout(label)
        width, height = body.get_pixel_size()
        self.remaining_offset = min(self.remaining_offset, max(0, width - available))
        color = label.get_style_context().get_color(label.get_state_flags())
        cr.save()
        cr.set_source_rgba(color.red, color.green, color.blue, color.alpha)
        y = (label.get_allocated_height() - height) / 2
        cr.move_to(0, y)
        PangoCairo.show_layout(cr, prefix)
        cr.rectangle(prefix_width, 0, available, label.get_allocated_height())
        cr.clip()
        cr.move_to(prefix_width - self.remaining_offset, y)
        PangoCairo.show_layout(cr, body)
        cr.restore()
        return True

    def scroll_remaining(self):
        label = find_widget(self.buttons["left"], Gtk.Label)
        now = monotonic()
        delta = min(now - self.remaining_last_tick, 0.1)
        self.remaining_last_tick = now
        _, body, _, available = self.remaining_layout(label)
        width, _ = body.get_pixel_size()
        maximum = max(0, width - available)
        if maximum == 0:
            self.remaining_offset = 0.0
        elif now >= self.remaining_wait_until:
            if self.remaining_offset >= maximum:
                self.remaining_offset = 0.0
                self.remaining_wait_until = now + 2
            else:
                self.remaining_offset = min(maximum, self.remaining_offset + delta * 35)
                if self.remaining_offset >= maximum:
                    self.remaining_wait_until = now + 2
        label.queue_draw()
        return True
